title: OpenFAWE: an open framework for coupled floating airborne wind energy dynamics and physics-linked cost screening

creators.name: Tian, Yinong
creators.affiliation: Centre for Marine Technology and Ocean Engineering (CENTEC), Instituto Superior Tecnico, University of Lisbon

contributors.name: Wang, Shan
contributors.affiliation: Centre for Marine Technology and Ocean Engineering (CENTEC), Instituto Superior Tecnico, University of Lisbon

notes: Project-owned code, models, scripts and data are released under Apache-2.0. Algorithms ported from the Vortex-Step-Method (MIT) and OpenFAST/OLAF (Apache-2.0) and the Makani M600 models and routines (Apache-2.0) keep their licences (NOTICE, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, third_party/). OpenFAWE reimplements its free-vortex-wake kernels from published formulations and regression cases and does not import or call MRUT (doi:10.17632/5jrdc8jb65.1), which remains a separate project.
description: OpenFAWE release 0.3.0: free-vortex-wake aerodynamics for airborne wind energy kites (vortex step method with a time-marching free wake, CPU and GPU tree codes, actuator-disc rotors releasing vortex rings, prescribed crosswind motions of one or several kites in one wake, lumped-mass tether, TU Delft V3 and Makani M600 models), with the code and data of arXiv:2610.37313. Control, ground station, power and floating-platform models are under development and not included.
